holder-quote: Orthenon raced ahead of the [Riders], a dark blur. The [Steward] was armed with a spear and his sword. He twisted as he raced at the [Charge Commander].
effect-quote: The [Steward] and his wedge of horses hit the spears. The pikes knocked [Riders] from horses, made some rear, took a few down. But for a few seconds, the flesh of his cavalry was steel.
His forces hit the first line of [Lineholders]. The Minotaurs, armed with axe and shield—stopped the charge.
